label: Workflow
description: The state machine of an entity: its states (each in a category such as active or resolved), the initial state, and the transitions between them, with guards, required fields, role restrictions, field values set on firing, button tone, and the declared events a transition publishes when it fires (emits, with payload expressions). The workflow owns the entity's status field, which changes only through transitions.
usage: Keep 4–7 states and name transitions as verbs ("Resolve", "Reopen").
Use requiredFields to collect information at the moment it matters (resolution notes on Resolve).
Use set to maintain timestamps and counters (resolved_at, reopen_count).
Set activeInstances to migrate with a stateMap when running records must follow a reshaped workflow; pin is the safe default.
constraints: stateField must be the entity's status field; its choice list option IDs must equal the state IDs.
initialState and every from/to must be states of the workflow; every state must be reachable from initialState.
guard is a CEL-subset expression; requiredFields and set keys must be fields of the entity and set may not target the status or system fields.

Each published change to the state field, initial state, states or transitions registers a new definition version; activeInstances decides whether running records stay pinned, migrate through stateMap, or move to cancelState (ADR 0015).
